items.title: Integrate role guidance with canonical acceptance topology and pre-review commands
items.context: Prompt guidance must direct roles to verifier-owned acceptance_topology_check and pre_review_check facts while CLI/handler gates remain authoritative; no prompt-only process fact.

happy.desc: Build and contract checks prove the mirrored Codex and Claude implementer/reviewer guidance names the canonical acceptance_topology_check, pre_review_check_read, acceptance rollout report/check, current-receipt, full-3x2, and rollback commands, while registered CLI/handler/process-fact consumers—not prompt prose—remain the only admission authority.

edge.desc: A mirror and mode-invariance check proves Codex and Claude guidance cannot drift and observe, warn, and enforce expose the same ordered diagnostics/status; only enforce changes blocking semantics.

adversarial.desc: Targeted mutations that remove a required command from either host prompt, replace full 3x2 with degraded 3x1, or claim prompt text is gate evidence must fail the mirror/process-fact contract with a stable reason, and restoration must return the clean control to PASS.

items.userSees: User sees `Role guidance contract: PASS` and both `codex` and `claude` rows name the canonical topology, pre-review, rollout-report, full-3x2, and rollback boundaries.

items.title: Produce verifier-owned before-and-after rollout cohorts and deterministic success metrics
items.context: Execute a reproducible baseline and candidate cohort on comparable high-assurance Stories, including seeded omission/forgery defects plus docs-only, legacy, and single-outcome false-block controls. Persist a signed/hash-bound rollout report; telemetry plumbing or synthetic-only unit coverage cannot satisfy this item.
items.userSees: User sees `Acceptance rollout report: PASS` followed by `sampleCount=3`, `seededDetection=100%`, `falseBlockRate=0%`, `waiverDelta=0`, `quorum=full-3x2`, and a signed receipt id.

happy.desc: A reproducible runner executes comparable real baseline and candidate high-assurance Story cohorts and the verifier deterministically derives aggregates and PASS/FAIL from source case records, binding the eligibility rule, evaluation window, complete eligible membership, at least 3 matched baseline/candidate pairs (at least 3 cases in each arm), sample identities, project/threshold version, story/material hashes, cost, review rounds, waivers, adapter results, and full-3x2 provider/quorum evidence into a signed/hash-verified receipt; caller-supplied membership, verdicts, or aggregates are rejected.

edge.desc: The same cohort includes docs-only, legacy, and ordinary single-outcome controls plus honest partial/unsupported adapter cases, reports a zero false-block rate for supported controls, and exposes identical computed metrics and diagnostics through write/read/check surfaces without mode-dependent relabeling.

adversarial.desc: Real-consumer seeded omission and forgery mutations—including removing C2 only from topology while its independently derived basis retains C2—must be detected across the registered campaign; omitting any eligible row, adding any ineligible row, altering the evaluation window, eligible membership, canonical order, membership digest, source rows, hashes, signature, freshness, provider identity, or using fewer than 3 matched pairs (fewer than 3 cases in either arm), and relabeling degraded 3x1 as full 3x2 must each fail with deterministic codes, then restoration must reproduce the clean PASS transcript.

items.title: Define bounded project-level warn-to-enforce admission thresholds
items.context: Resolve Wave 4 policy questions with explicit claim taxonomies, supported adapter sufficiency, minimum sample size, zero mislabeled 3x1, 100% supported omission detection, and fail-closed threshold evaluation. Keep flat project scope; Wave 3A selective applicability remains excluded.

happy.desc: The canonical flat project policy mechanically requires transcripts for user-visible/orchestration claims, biting mutations for behavior/lifecycle/proof/safety with docs-only exemption, registered supported adapter profiles, at least 3 comparable matched samples in each cohort arm, an overall false-pass rate of 0 across every registered seeded defect class, 100% supported omission detection, 0% false blocks, 0 mislabeled 3x1 campaigns, waiver delta <=0, and a non-shrinking check inventory before warn-to-enforce admission can PASS.

edge.desc: Insufficient samples, unknown/partial/unsupported adapters, unexplained adapter disagreement, and claim-taxonomy gaps fail promotion with stable diagnostics while remaining honestly partial/unsupported; flat project scope is preserved and no selective Story/policy applicability is inferred without Wave 3A.

adversarial.desc: Boundary mutations at fewer than 3 matched pairs, any incomplete registered seeded-defect campaign, any missed non-omission seeded defect, overall false-pass above 0, omission detection below 100%, false-block above 0, any mislabeled 3x1, positive waiver delta, or a removed check must each fail closed; caller attempts to lower thresholds, omit adapter or campaign records, forge aggregate PASS, or exploit observe/warn mode must not change the canonical diagnostic result.

items.userSees: User sees `Acceptance rollout policy: PASS promotionEligible=true`; insufficient samples, partial adapters, any false block, waiver increase, inventory shrink, or degraded 3x1 instead show a named failure code.

items.title: Implement opt-in enforcement and tested rollback without weakening checks
items.context: Promotion must mechanically consume a current verifier-owned PASS rollout-report receipt whose cohort meets the configured thresholds, plus existing full 3x2 high-risk review/quorum. Missing/stale/failing reports, degraded 3x1, increased waivers, or weaker checks fail closed. Rollback removes blocking without rewriting report/evidence history.
items.userSees: User sees `Acceptance rollout enforcement: PASS mode=enforce receipt=current quorum=full-3x2`; after rollback the UI shows `mode=warn blocking=false historyPreserved=true`.

happy.desc: An explicit project-level enforce promotion succeeds only when the gate mechanically verifies a current signed PASS rollout receipt whose cohort satisfies every configured threshold and a current genuine full-3x2 quorum; a tested rollback to warn/observe removes blocking while preserving the report, receipt, prior mode transitions, diagnostics, and evidence history byte-for-byte.

edge.desc: Observe, warn, and enforce compute the same status, ordered diagnostics, threshold evaluation, and receipt classification; observe/warn remain non-blocking, enforce alone changes admission, and repeated promotion/rollback is deterministic without selective per-Story behavior.

adversarial.desc: Clean control PASS → independently target missing/stale/tampered/failing receipt, degraded 3x1, forged host identity, positive waiver delta, weaker inventory, false-block, and omission-detection failures → each real gate consumer must reject with its named code → restoration must return clean PASS; rollback must never delete or rewrite the failed attempts or historical signed artifacts.

That suite genuinely discharges this intent: it drives clean-control PASS, then targets substituted caller reports, a missing restoration commit, and a forged restoration commit, and each must be rejected before the observation is signed; exit 0 PASS (7 assertions). It is not claimed as coverage of this intent; it simply travels in the same suite. The default-mode 57-assertion suite remains bound by the other 7 intent refs, so no coverage was lost by rebinding this one.

items.title: Update the canonical execution plan with measured Wave 4 status and operator guidance
items.context: After implementation and real cohort evidence pass, replace the canonical Wave 4 NOT IMPLEMENTED marker with the exact implemented boundary, chosen thresholds, measured results, rollback procedure, and explicit Wave 3A exclusion. Do not overstate selective applicability or authority.
items.userSees: User sees the canonical guide state `Wave 4 — IMPLEMENTED (flat measured rollout)` with the exact report/check commands, thresholds, measured result, rollback procedure, and `Wave 3A: not implemented` boundary.
excludes: Selective per-Story or per-policy enforcement without Wave 3A

happy.desc: Only after the real cohort and enforcement/rollback verification pass, docs checks prove the canonical Story 6 plan and CLI guide consistently replace Wave 4 NOT IMPLEMENTED with the exact demonstrated flat-rollout status, thresholds, measured cohort results, reproducible commands, receipt/quorum authority boundary, and rollback procedure.

edge.desc: Canonical documentation explicitly keeps Wave 3A selective per-Story/per-policy applicability unimplemented and excluded, describes partial/unsupported adapters and degraded 3x1 as non-authority, and does not promote local full-3x2 evidence into production/public authority.

adversarial.desc: A docs/contract audit must fail if Wave 4 status is advanced without the current signed rollout receipt, if quoted metrics/thresholds/commands disagree with verifier output, if rollback history is described as deletable, if Wave 3A is implied implemented, or if any stale NOT IMPLEMENTED/overbroad authority claim contradicts the canonical status.
